title: 1936 Prairie: the Allerton house rises to its 44-foot cornice
items: The Allerton house's bracketed cornice now stands at the 44 feet the 1869 Tribune gives, 1.2 m higher than before; the attic's frieze lights, the roof deck and the chimneys rise with it.
Its tower is re-proportioned to the winter photograph: the main cornice now runs round the tower, and the short, windowless stage over it carries the belvedere's balcony nearer the roof.
